info.name: Brushfire API: Version 2025-07-22 AccessCodes Cart API
Retrieve events and attendees for a specific cart

params.name: cartId
params.description: A valid CartId that was previously generated by /cart/id

params.name: accessKey
params.description: The Access Key for the user context

params.name: pos
params.description: A boolean indicating if this cart should be retrieved for POS mode

params.name: exclude
params.description: A comma-separated list of GUIDs representing the ID of each promotion you would like to exclude from the cart

params.name: originalOrderId
params.description: A valid OrderId to ease adding other attendees and add-ons

params.name: exchangeId
params.description: A valid ExchangeId to associate this cart with an exchange

items.docs: Retrieve events and attendees for a specific cart
